notes: v8.9.8: Apps on the PC — agent lists installed apps from the Start Menu with live running state (Toolhelp snapshot), launches only allowlisted apps, and kills by PID (never itself); relay stores the list per device in devices.json and serves it cached. Console v10.8: Apps panel (list, Launch, Kill with confirm, Refresh, cached list when offline); touch long-press = right click, touch drag now holds the button, double-tap = double-click. v8.9.7: startup now logs session + elevated state (to settle admin-vs-session questions), viewer mic packets are logged like viewer frames. Console v10.7: the PC-camera demo no longer re-covers live video on every av-state. v8.9.6: wake launches the agent in the user's session (not session 0), silent screen/camera failures now log, installer gains a logo mark, multi-size icon, install-location picker and wake-service option; console sends viewer camera frames from call start. v8.9.5: device duplication fix + call-end grace. (1) One identity per PC: the agent config now lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\SWRemote\swremote.json (the install folder the installer and wake service already use) instead of next to the exe — before, every copy of the agent (Downloads, Desktop, install folder) minted its own device ID and the console filled with duplicates. First 8.9.5 run migrates the exe-side file and rewrites it to match, so all copies converge. (2) Call-end grace: an End no longer tears down at once — the call holds 15s and a rejoin resumes the same call; only the real teardown is broadcast to every viewer with who ended it, so no viewer is left on a dead call thinking it auto-disconnected. Call-end messages now carry the sender name (agent logs it). (3) Relay device removal now also forgets the local record, so a removed device cannot be PIN-joined back until it re-registers. Console v10.5: End sends the viewer name; the ended toast names who ended it; SW cache v17.
